summary: First live execution of the GRADE_PRIMARY benchmark. It validated the INFRASTRUCTURE and found four blockers. It did NOT measure grading quality and must never be cited as a comparative result.
reasons: benchmark target semantics unresolved: GradeResult.score was compared against the instructor FINAL sub-item score, but production uses that number only as a ratio quantised to a 3-level explanation verdict (reliability._verdict_from_score); the final number is computed deterministically from selection_correct x verdict factor (grade.py:471). selected=None for 67/67 cases, so the selection half of that product was withheld from the model.
transport: openai/gpt-5.6-luna-pro produced 0 tokens — every call rejected pre-inference with HTTP 400 invalid_json_schema (missing additionalProperties:false).

route parity: models.toml [models.grade_primary].reasoning={effort='none'} never reached the provider; reasoning consumed 1106/1262 gemini output tokens and truncated one sonnet case at max_tokens=600.
accounting: the local ledger recorded $0.019786 against $0.030510 of true account spend; the failed-but-billed truncated call was not ledgered.
do_not_cite: gemini 1/3 exact and sonnet 0/2 exact are NOT accuracy measurements. Every parsed grade was 0.0, which the corrected semantics predict for an input with no selection.
next_valid_run_requires: grading semantics decision (benchmark target: explanation verdict, not final score)
